reason: The pictured fibroblast route starts with unspecialized cells and leads to connective-tissue cells, so it looks relevant to making supporting material.
expectation: A subset of the stem cells will follow the pictured route toward fibroblasts.

alternatives.reason: The other pictured route could prepare the muscle-forming cells first.

effect: The fibroblast route produced cells with active collagen messages, while leaving stem cells for the muscle branch.
reaction: The unchanged DNA alongside active collagen genes makes the different-work idea clearer.
reason: The messages lead toward ribosomes, and amino acids are the building blocks for proteins. This seems like a way to make collagen, though I don't yet know how it becomes supporting material outside the cells.
expectation: The cells will use the amino acids to make collagen protein.

alternatives.reason: I could start the separate muscle branch instead.

effect: The fibroblasts used amino acids to make collagen precursors, which are packaged for secretion; the supporting material is not outside yet.
reaction: The connection from the RNA message to protein production is clearer.
reason: The precursors are in secretory vesicles, and extracellular fluid is outside the cells, so this looks like the next step toward supporting material.
expectation: The fibroblasts will release collagen precursors outside the cells, where they may form supporting material.

alternatives.reason: I could work on the separate muscle branch first.

effect: The collagen precursors were released and assembled into supporting material outside the cells, completing that goal.
reaction: It is clearer that tissue includes material around cells as well as the cells themselves.
reason: The remaining goal is to prepare muscle-forming cells, and the pictured muscle conditions show a route from unspecialized cells to muscle precursors.
expectation: A separate subset of stem cells will develop toward muscle precursors.

effect: The muscle conditions produced committed cells with muscle-protein messages, but they are still individual cells rather than mature fibres.
reaction: It is clear that this branch uses different genes from the same inherited DNA.
reason: The cells have messages for muscle proteins, and amino acids supplied the building blocks for collagen proteins in the other branch.
expectation: The muscle-lineage cells will use the amino acids to make muscle proteins and progress toward muscle-forming cells.

effect: The muscle cells used amino acids to make muscle proteins, completing the goal, but they are still separate precursors rather than mature muscle fibres.
reaction: It was useful to see that both branches used the same building blocks for different proteins.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making the collagen-rich matrix was most worthwhile: it showed how cells produce supporting material outside themselves, and that tissue includes that material too.

leastWorthwhile.text: The muscle branch repeated the message-and-amino-acid pairing from the fibroblast branch, so its final step felt somewhat predictable.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected the supporting material to be assembled outside the cells after they released collagen precursors.

arbitrary.text: The differentiation conditions were named for their destinations, but the changing signals and why they lead to those particular cells weren't explained in much detail. I followed the pictured routes rather than understanding the signals themselves.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, mainly to see how the separate muscle precursors develop into mature fibres; the result says there is more development ahead.
